setup.en: Use a rack with catches just below your controlled squat depth. Set the hooks below shoulder height, secure the plates with collars and learn with an unloaded bar.
setup.zh: 在深蹲架里练，保护杠略低于你能控制的最低点。挂钩低于肩，上好杠片卡扣，先用空杠学动作。

steps.en: Stand under the bar and rest it on the muscular shelf of the upper back, not the neck. Use a closed overhand grip wider than the shoulders.
steps.zh: 站到杠下，把杠放在上背肌肉形成的平台上，不压颈部。正握，拇指扣住，握距比肩宽。

steps.en: Brace the trunk, stand to clear the hooks and take small steps back. Set feet at a comfortable width with toes turned out slightly.
steps.zh: 躯干收紧，站起取杠，小步退开。双脚取舒服站距，脚尖略朝外。

steps.en: Keep the whole foot planted and bend hips and knees together. Let the knees travel in the direction of the toes as the hips descend.
steps.zh: 全脚掌踩稳，同时屈髋屈膝；髋往下走时，膝顺着脚尖方向移动。

steps.en: Lower only while you can keep a steady spine and balanced feet. The knees may pass the toes; do not force them back by folding the trunk.
steps.zh: 只下到脊柱和双脚仍能稳住的深度。膝可以超过脚尖，不要为了往后收膝而过度折叠躯干。

steps.en: Push the floor away and straighten hips and knees together. Stop at a tall stance without leaning backwards.
steps.zh: 把地面推开，髋和膝一起伸直。站稳就停，不向后仰。

steps.en: Walk forward until the bar contacts the uprights, then lower onto both hooks before releasing your grip.
steps.zh: 往前走到杠碰立柱，确认落在两边挂钩上，再松手。

cues.en: Keep heel, base of the big toe and base of the little toe in contact.
cues.zh: 脚跟、大脚趾根和小脚趾根都贴地。

cues.en: Let knees follow toes and keep the load over the midfoot.
cues.zh: 膝沿脚尖方向走，负荷保持在脚掌中部上方。

mistakes.en: Forcing the knees to remain behind the toes. Why: this can shift the demand towards the hips and increase forward trunk lean.
mistakes.zh: 硬把膝限制在脚尖后。为什么：这可能把更多负荷转向髋，让躯干更前倾。

mistakes.en: Dropping into a depth where the feet or trunk lose control. Why: the load then changes position abruptly and is harder to reverse smoothly.
mistakes.zh: 蹲到双脚或躯干失控的深度。为什么：负荷位置突然改变，难以平稳起身。

text.en: Begin with a load and range you can control; increase the challenge gradually as the same movement becomes easier.
text.zh: 先用能控制的负荷与幅度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: The 3D model keeps the feet flat on the floor and shows a partial-depth version so the muscle shapes stay clean. Go as deep as your mobility and a coach allow; follow the sketch and the steps.
cautions.zh: 3D 模型让双脚平踩地面，只做到较浅的深度，这样肌肉形状不会被拉变形。真实动作请按你的活动度和教练的指导决定深度，并按示意图和步骤来做。

cautions.en: Practise the rack exit with a coach and use correctly set catches; stop for sharp knee, hip or back pain.
cautions.zh: 请教练指导出杠并调好保护杠；膝、髋或背出现刺痛就停下。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

text.en: Fry, Smith and Schilling (2003) compared parallel squats with and without a barrier restricting knee travel in seven weight-trained men, using a barbell load equal to body mass. Restriction reduced estimated knee torque but increased hip torque. This was a biomechanics study, not an injury trial; knee travel past the toes alone does not establish harm.
text.zh: Fry、Smith 和 Schilling（2003）让七名有训练男性用与体重相当的杠铃做平行深蹲，比较挡板限制膝前移与不限制的情况。限制后，估算的膝力矩下降，髋力矩上升。这是生物力学研究，不是损伤试验；不能单凭膝超过脚尖就认定有害。

setup.en: Choose a light dumbbell you can hold securely at the chest. Clear a non-slip floor; a coach can help you find a comfortable stance.
setup.zh: 用能稳稳抱在胸前的轻哑铃。在防滑地面留出空间，请教练帮你找舒服的站距。

steps.en: Hold the upper dumbbell head with both palms, the handle pointing down, and keep the weight close to the chest.
steps.zh: 双手托住哑铃上端，握杆朝下，哑铃贴近胸前。

steps.en: Set feet at a comfortable width and angle. Stand tall with elbows below the weight and wrists close to straight.
steps.zh: 双脚取舒服站距和脚尖角度。站稳，肘在重量下方，手腕尽量平直。

steps.en: Breathe in and bend hips and knees together. Keep the whole foot down while the knees follow the toes.
steps.zh: 吸气，同时屈髋屈膝。全脚掌贴地，膝沿脚尖方向走。

steps.en: Lower to a depth you can reverse without the heels rising or the trunk folding. Keep the dumbbell near the chest.
steps.zh: 下到脚跟不抬、躯干不折叠且能平稳起身的深度，哑铃始终靠近胸口。

steps.en: Breathe out and push through the feet to stand tall. Finish before the back arches or the knees snap backwards.
steps.zh: 呼气，用双脚推地站起。站稳即停，不塌腰，也不猛顶膝。

cues.en: Sit between your feet, not onto your toes.
cues.zh: 往双脚之间坐，不把重量压到脚尖上。

cues.en: Keep the dumbbell close and feel the front thighs and buttocks work.
cues.zh: 哑铃靠近身体，留意大腿前侧和臀部用力。

mistakes.en: Holding the weight far from the chest. Why: this increases the pull on the arms and trunk and can disturb balance.
mistakes.zh: 哑铃离胸口太远。为什么：手臂和躯干的负担变大，也更难平衡。

mistakes.en: Lifting the heels to reach a lower position. Why: the support base changes and depth replaces foot control.
mistakes.zh: 为了蹲深而抬脚跟。为什么：支撑位置改变，只顾深度却失去足部控制。

text.en: Begin with a load and range you can control; increase the challenge gradually as the same movement becomes easier.
text.zh: 先用能控制的负荷与幅度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: The 3D model keeps the feet flat on the floor and shows a partial-depth version so the muscle shapes stay clean. Go as deep as your mobility and a coach allow; follow the sketch and the steps.
cautions.zh: 3D 模型让双脚平踩地面，只做到较浅的深度，这样肌肉形状不会被拉变形。真实动作请按你的活动度和教练的指导决定深度，并按示意图和步骤来做。

cautions.en: Put the dumbbell down before it slips; do not trap fingers between its head and the floor.
cautions.zh: 哑铃快滑脱时先放下，别让手指夹在哑铃头和地面之间。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Clear a non-slip floor. Stand near a stable support if balance is unfamiliar; begin without added weight.
setup.zh: 在防滑地面留出空间。不熟悉平衡时靠近稳固扶手，先不加重量。

steps.en: Stand with feet hip-width apart and lightly brace the trunk. Use a fingertip on a support if needed.
steps.zh: 双脚与髋同宽，躯干稍收紧；需要时用指尖轻扶。

steps.en: Leave the left foot planted and step the right foot back onto its ball. Keep some sideways space between the feet.
steps.zh: 左脚踩稳，右脚向后迈，前脚掌着地；两脚之间保留横向间距。

steps.en: Bend both knees and lower the pelvis between the feet. Keep the front foot flat and the front knee following its toes.
steps.zh: 屈双膝，骨盆在两脚之间下降；前脚踩平，前膝沿脚尖方向走。

steps.en: Stop before the back knee hits the floor or you lose balance. A small whole-trunk lean is acceptable with the spine steady.
steps.zh: 后膝碰地或失去平衡前停下。躯干可以整体略前倾，脊柱保持稳定。

steps.en: Press through the front foot, rise and bring the back foot forward under control. Practise the opposite side with the same care.
steps.zh: 用前脚推地，站起，后脚有控制地收回；另一侧同样认真练。

cues.en: Use railway tracks rather than a tightrope for foot placement.
cues.zh: 两脚像踩两条轨道，不走独木桥。

cues.en: Feel the front thigh and buttock work while the pelvis stays level.
cues.zh: 留意前腿大腿和臀部用力，骨盆别向一侧掉。

mistakes.en: Stepping directly behind the front foot. Why: the narrow base makes balance harder and encourages sideways drift.
mistakes.zh: 后脚踩到前脚正后方。为什么：支撑面太窄，更难平衡，也容易向侧面歪。

mistakes.en: Dropping the back knee onto the floor. Why: impact replaces a controlled change of direction.
mistakes.zh: 后膝砸地。为什么：冲击代替了有控制的换向。

text.en: Use hand support or a shallower range until balance is steady; increase the range before adding an external load.
text.zh: 先扶稳或减小幅度；平衡稳定后先逐步加大幅度，再考虑外加重量。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: The 3D model keeps the feet flat on the floor and shows a partial-depth version so the muscle shapes stay clean. Go as deep as your mobility and a coach allow; follow the sketch and the steps.
cautions.zh: 3D 模型让双脚平踩地面，只做到较浅的深度，这样肌肉形状不会被拉变形。真实动作请按你的活动度和教练的指导决定深度，并按示意图和步骤来做。

cautions.en: Use a support and shorter depth if balance is uncertain; stop if knee or hip pain appears.
cautions.zh: 平衡不稳就扶稳、减小深度；膝或髋疼就停下。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Learn the sideways step without load first. Use a light dumbbell held at the chest and clear space on both sides.
setup.zh: 先徒手学横向迈步，再用轻哑铃抱在胸前；身体两侧留出空间。

steps.en: Stand tall, holding a vertical dumbbell close to the chest with both hands under its upper head.
steps.zh: 站稳，双手托住哑铃上端，竖着抱在胸前。

steps.en: Step the left foot sideways and place the whole foot down. Keep the right foot facing mostly forwards.
steps.zh: 左脚向侧面迈，全脚掌落地；右脚大致朝前。

steps.en: Bend the left hip and knee and send the hips back over that leg. Let the right knee remain nearly straight without locking it.
steps.zh: 屈左髋左膝，髋往后坐向左腿；右膝保持较直，但别硬锁。

steps.en: Lower only while the left knee follows the toes and both feet stay planted. Do not force a deep inner-thigh stretch.
steps.zh: 只下到左膝仍沿脚尖走、双脚仍踩稳的位置；不要强追大腿内侧拉伸。

steps.en: Push through the left foot and bring it back beneath the pelvis. Return slowly and practise the other side.
steps.zh: 用左脚推地，把脚收回骨盆下方；慢慢回位，再练另一侧。

cues.en: Sit back over the stepping leg; keep the weight close.
cues.zh: 髋往迈步腿后方坐，哑铃靠近身体。

cues.en: The long leg stays quiet while the bent leg controls the return.
cues.zh: 伸直的那条腿保持稳定，由弯曲的腿控制回位。

mistakes.en: Turning the planted foot while the knee is loaded. Why: rotation is passed into the knee instead of being a controlled hip movement.
mistakes.zh: 膝负重时扭动踩地脚。为什么：旋转传到膝，而不是有控制地在髋发生。

mistakes.en: Taking an excessively wide step. Why: the groin can be pulled beyond a range you can reverse smoothly.
mistakes.zh: 步子跨得过宽。为什么：腹股沟可能被拉到无法平稳回位的范围。

text.en: Begin with a load and range you can control; increase the challenge gradually as the same movement becomes easier.
text.zh: 先用能控制的负荷与幅度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: The 3D model keeps the feet flat on the floor and shows a partial-depth version so the muscle shapes stay clean. Go as deep as your mobility and a coach allow; follow the sketch and the steps.
cautions.zh: 3D 模型让双脚平踩地面，只做到较浅的深度，这样肌肉形状不会被拉变形。真实动作请按你的活动度和教练的指导决定深度，并按示意图和步骤来做。

cautions.en: Stop for sharp groin pain; reduce step width rather than forcing the inner thigh.
cautions.zh: 腹股沟刺痛就停；缩小步幅，不要硬拉大腿内侧。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a light bar with collars and a clear landing area. Lift it into the standing start from rack hooks around thigh height; learn the hip hinge before loading it.
setup.zh: 用轻杠，上卡扣，留出放杠空间。挂钩约在大腿高度，从架上取到站姿起点；加重前先学髋铰链。

steps.en: Stand with feet about hip-width apart. Take a closed overhand grip just outside the thighs and hold the bar in front of them.
steps.zh: 双脚约与髋同宽，正握，拇指扣住，双手在大腿外侧，杠放在腿前。

steps.en: Soften the knees and keep that small bend. Brace the trunk and let the arms hang long.
steps.zh: 膝稍屈，之后基本保持这个弯曲；躯干收紧，手臂自然垂长。

steps.en: Send the hips backwards while the trunk tips forward as a unit. Keep the bar close to the legs.
steps.zh: 髋向后送，躯干作为整体前倾，杠始终靠近腿。

steps.en: Stop when the back thighs feel tension and you can still keep the spine steady. The bar need not reach the floor.
steps.zh: 大腿后侧有牵拉感、脊柱仍稳住时停；杠不必碰地。

steps.en: Push the feet into the floor and bring the hips forwards to stand. Keep the arms long and finish without leaning back.
steps.zh: 双脚推地，把髋带回前方站起；手臂保持垂长，不向后仰。

steps.en: After the last movement, return the bar to the hooks or lower it using a controlled hip and knee bend.
steps.zh: 结束后把杠放回挂钩，或有控制地屈髋屈膝把它放下。

cues.en: Move the hips backwards as if closing a door behind you.
cues.zh: 像用臀部关上身后的门，让髋往后走。

cues.en: Keep the bar near the thighs and shins; feel the back thighs and buttocks.
cues.zh: 杠贴近大腿和小腿，留意大腿后侧、臀部用力。

mistakes.en: Reaching for the floor by rounding the back. Why: spinal motion replaces the controlled hip range.
mistakes.zh: 弓背去够地面。为什么：脊柱运动代替了有控制的髋运动。

mistakes.en: Turning the hinge into a squat by bending the knees further. Why: this changes the hamstrings starting length and the movement pattern.
mistakes.zh: 越下越屈膝，把髋铰链变成深蹲。为什么：腘绳肌起始长度和动作模式都改变了。

text.en: Begin with a load and range you can control; increase the challenge gradually as the same movement becomes easier.
text.zh: 先用能控制的负荷与幅度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: The 3D model shows the hinge by tipping the whole body forward at the hips; it has no arms or bar. Follow the sketch and the steps for the real exercise.
cautions.zh: 3D 模型以髋为轴把整个身体向前倾来表示髋铰链，没有手臂，也没有杠铃。真实动作请按示意图和步骤来做。

cautions.en: Stop for back pain, numbness or a sharp pull in the posterior thigh. Have a coach check the hinge before adding load.
cautions.zh: 背痛、麻木或大腿后侧突然锐痛就停；加重前请教练检查髋铰链。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Adjust a seated leg-curl machine so its pivot lines up with the side of the knee. Set the lower roller above the heel and the thigh pad above the knees; begin with a light selection.
setup.zh: 调坐姿腿弯举机，使转轴对准膝侧。下方滚垫放在脚跟上方，大腿压垫位于膝上；先选轻配重。

steps.en: Sit against the back pad with the hips flexed and hold the handles with a closed neutral grip.
steps.zh: 坐稳，背靠垫，髋保持屈曲，用对握握住把手，拇指扣住。

steps.en: Secure the thigh pad without squeezing the kneecaps. Set the starting knee extension to a comfortable range.
steps.zh: 固定大腿压垫，不压髌骨；起始伸膝幅度以舒服为准。

steps.en: Keep the pelvis still and pull the lower roller down and back by bending the knees. Keep ankles relaxed near neutral.
steps.zh: 骨盆不动，屈膝把下方滚垫往下、往后拉；踝放松在近中立位。

steps.en: Pause at the bend you can reach without lifting the thighs or arching the back.
steps.zh: 屈到大腿不抬、背不后仰且能控制的位置，稍停。

steps.en: Let the knees straighten slowly to the chosen start. Return the lever fully before releasing the pad and leaving the seat.
steps.zh: 慢慢伸膝回到设定起点；结束时先把杠杆完全送回，再松压垫离座。

cues.en: Move the knees, not the pelvis.
cues.zh: 动膝，不动骨盆。

cues.en: Feel the posterior thigh work and let the stack return quietly.
cues.zh: 留意大腿后侧用力，配重轻轻回落。

mistakes.en: Using a machine pivot far from the knee. Why: the pad can slide and push the leg along an uncomfortable path.
mistakes.zh: 器械转轴离膝太远。为什么：滚垫容易滑动，把腿带上不舒服的路线。

mistakes.en: Lifting the hips to finish the curl. Why: the hip position changes and momentum replaces knee-flexor work.
mistakes.zh: 为了弯到底而抬髋。为什么：髋姿势改变，惯性代替了屈膝肌用力。

text.en: Begin with a load and range you can control; increase the challenge gradually as the same movement becomes easier.
text.zh: 先用能控制的负荷与幅度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: Keep fingers clear of levers and the stack; do not force full knee extension if it produces pain.
cautions.zh: 手指远离杠杆和配重；伸膝到头会痛时不要硬顶。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Fit an ankle cuff to a low pulley. Stand with the right side towards the column so the left leg moves away from it; hold a fixed support. Select a light load.
setup.zh: 低滑轮接踝带。右侧朝向器械，让左腿向远离滑轮方向抬；扶稳，选轻配重。

steps.en: Secure the cuff above the left ankle and check that the clip is closed. Stand on the right leg with that knee slightly soft.
steps.zh: 踝带固定在左踝上方，确认挂扣闭合。右腿支撑，膝稍放松。

steps.en: Keep the pelvis level and the left toes facing forwards. Hold the support with a comfortable closed grip.
steps.zh: 骨盆摆平，左脚尖朝前，用舒服的闭合握法扶稳。

steps.en: Move the left thigh sideways away from the column without turning the foot or leaning the trunk.
steps.zh: 左大腿向侧面离开滑轮，不转脚，也不侧倾躯干。

steps.en: Stop while the pelvis still stays level. Pause briefly and notice effort at the upper outer hip.
steps.zh: 骨盆仍能摆平时停，稍停一下，留意髋外上方用力。

steps.en: Bring the leg back slowly without allowing the stack to crash. Rest the stack before removing the cuff and changing sides.
steps.zh: 慢慢收回，不让配重砸下；配重停稳后再解踝带换侧。

cues.en: Move the thigh; keep your belt line quiet.
cues.zh: 动大腿，裤腰保持平稳。

cues.en: A small controlled arc is enough.
cues.zh: 小幅度、可控制的弧线就够了。

cues.en: The moving hip pulls outward; the supporting hip also works to keep the pelvis steady.
cues.zh: 移动侧髋向外拉，支撑侧髋也在用力稳住骨盆。

mistakes.en: Leaning away from the column. Why: trunk movement makes the leg look higher without more hip abduction.
mistakes.zh: 向远离器械方向侧倾。为什么：躯干运动让腿看起来抬高了，髋外展却没增加。

mistakes.en: Turning the toes strongly inward or outward. Why: it changes the task rather than keeping a repeatable sideways pull.
mistakes.zh: 脚尖使劲朝内或朝外拧。为什么：动作任务改变，侧向拉不再稳定一致。

text.en: Begin with a load and range you can control; increase the challenge gradually as the same movement becomes easier.
text.zh: 先用能控制的负荷与幅度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: Check the cuff and use fixed hand support. Stop if the cuff causes numbness or the hip pinches.
cautions.zh: 检查踝带，手扶固定支撑；踝带压出麻木或髋夹痛就停。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Attach an ankle cuff to the low pulley. Stand with the left side near the column and support your weight on the right foot. Hold a fixed support and use a light selection.
setup.zh: 低滑轮接踝带，左侧靠近器械，右脚支撑；扶固定支撑，选轻配重。

steps.en: Fasten the cuff above the left ankle and take enough sideways space for the cable to stay lightly taut.
steps.zh: 踝带扣在左踝上方，站开一些，让绳索轻轻绷紧。

steps.en: Let the left leg start a little out to the side, knee softly extended. Keep the pelvis facing forwards.
steps.zh: 左腿从略外展位开始，膝自然较直；骨盆朝前。

steps.en: Draw the left thigh inward towards the support leg. Keep toes facing forwards and avoid swinging.
steps.zh: 左大腿向支撑腿靠拢，脚尖朝前，不甩腿。

steps.en: Stop near the midline before the legs collide or the pelvis turns. Notice effort in the inner thigh.
steps.zh: 靠近中线就停，别撞腿，也别转骨盆；留意大腿内侧用力。

steps.en: Let the cable draw the leg back out slowly. Set the stack down before removing the cuff and changing sides.
steps.zh: 慢慢让绳索把腿拉回外侧；配重停稳后再解踝带换侧。

cues.en: Pull the thigh inward while keeping the belt line square.
cues.zh: 大腿向内拉，裤腰仍朝前。

cues.en: Keep the return as quiet as the inward pull.
cues.zh: 向外回位也和向内拉一样平稳。

mistakes.en: Crossing far past the support leg. Why: the pelvis often turns and replaces the intended hip motion.
mistakes.zh: 跨过支撑腿很远。为什么：骨盆常会跟着转，代替原本的髋运动。

mistakes.en: Starting with a very wide spread. Why: the groin may be pulled beyond a controlled range.
mistakes.zh: 起点张腿过宽。为什么：腹股沟可能被拉到无法控制的范围。

text.en: Begin with a load and range you can control; increase the challenge gradually as the same movement becomes easier.
text.zh: 先用能控制的负荷与幅度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: Avoid forcing a groin stretch or using a loose support. Stop for sharp inner-thigh pain.
cautions.zh: 别强拉腹股沟，也别扶会移动的物体；大腿内侧刺痛就停。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Stand on a level non-slip floor beside a fixed support. Hold a light dumbbell in one hand and use the other for balance; begin with both feet carrying your weight.
setup.zh: 站在平整防滑地面，身旁有固定扶手。一手持轻哑铃，另一手扶稳；先双脚一起承重。

steps.en: Set the feet hip-width apart, toes roughly forwards. Hold the dumbbell at the side with a neutral closed grip.
steps.zh: 双脚与髋同宽，脚尖大致朝前；哑铃垂在身侧，对握，拇指扣住。

steps.en: Stand tall with knees comfortably straight but not pushed backwards. Use the support for balance rather than pulling upwards.
steps.zh: 站稳，膝自然伸直，不向后顶；扶手只帮平衡，不把人拉上去。

steps.en: Press through the balls of both feet and lift the heels slowly. Keep pressure spread across the forefoot.
steps.zh: 两脚前脚掌推地，慢慢提脚跟；压力分布在整个前脚掌。

steps.en: Pause at a height you can hold without rolling the ankles or bending the knees. Notice effort through the calf.
steps.zh: 提到踝不歪、膝不屈且能停稳的高度，留意小腿用力。

steps.en: Lower the heels slowly to the floor. Set the dumbbell down under control when finished.
steps.zh: 脚跟慢慢落回地面，结束后把哑铃稳稳放下。

cues.en: Rise straight up, not onto the outer toes.
cues.zh: 笔直向上提，不要滚到外侧脚趾上。

cues.en: Let the ankles move while the knees stay quiet.
cues.zh: 让踝运动，膝保持稳定。

mistakes.en: Bouncing off the floor. Why: rebound hides how well the calf controls the lowering phase.
mistakes.zh: 借地面反弹。为什么：反弹掩盖了小腿对下放的控制。

mistakes.en: Rolling onto the outside of the feet. Why: this changes support and makes the rise less steady.
mistakes.zh: 脚掌滚到外缘。为什么：支撑改变，提起更不稳。

text.en: Begin with a load and range you can control; increase the challenge gradually as the same movement becomes easier.
text.zh: 先用能控制的负荷与幅度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: Begin on the floor rather than an edge; stop for sharp Achilles or foot pain.
cautions.zh: 先在平地做，不站高台边缘；跟腱或足部刺痛就停。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a stable flat bench and a light dumbbell. Cushion the lower thighs and rest the weight across them above the knees, holding it securely with both hands.
setup.zh: 用稳固平板凳和轻哑铃。大腿下端垫软垫，哑铃横放在膝上方的大腿上，双手扶牢。

steps.en: Sit tall with feet hip-width apart and knees bent near a right angle. Put the forefeet flat on the floor.
steps.zh: 坐稳，双脚与髋同宽，膝约屈成直角，前脚掌平踩地面。

steps.en: Place the cushioned dumbbell above the knees, not on the kneecaps. Hold it so it cannot roll.
steps.zh: 带垫的哑铃放在膝上方，不压髌骨；扶牢，不让它滚动。

steps.en: Keep the knee angle steady and press the forefeet down to lift the heels.
steps.zh: 膝角度不变，用前脚掌推地，把脚跟提起。

steps.en: Pause without leaning backwards or lifting the thighs by hand. Notice the lower calf working.
steps.zh: 停稳，不后仰，也不用手抬大腿，留意小腿下部用力。

steps.en: Lower the heels slowly to the floor and keep the weight secure. Remove it from the thighs before standing.
steps.zh: 脚跟慢慢落地，始终扶住重量；先移开哑铃，再站起来。

cues.en: Keep the bend at the knees while moving the ankles.
cues.zh: 保持屈膝，让踝运动。

cues.en: Rise and lower without bouncing the weight.
cues.zh: 重量平稳升降，不弹。

mistakes.en: Putting the weight directly on the kneecaps. Why: pressure falls on a bony surface instead of the supported thigh.
mistakes.zh: 哑铃直接压髌骨。为什么：压力落在骨面上，而不是有支撑的大腿上。

mistakes.en: Lifting the thighs with the hands. Why: the hands unload the calves instead of stabilising the weight.
mistakes.zh: 用手抬大腿。为什么：手把小腿该承担的负荷卸掉了。

text.en: Begin with a load and range you can control; increase the challenge gradually as the same movement becomes easier.
text.zh: 先用能控制的负荷与幅度；同样的动作变得轻松后，再逐步加难。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: Use padding and a light secure weight; stop for knee pressure pain or Achilles pain.
cautions.zh: 垫好，重量轻且固定稳；膝受压痛或跟腱痛就停。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a clear non-slip floor and a stable wall. Lean the upper back against it with feet slightly forward; choose a distance that lets the heels stay planted.
setup.zh: 用防滑地面和稳固墙面。上背靠墙，双脚略向前伸，距离以脚跟能踩稳为准。

steps.en: Place the upper back against the wall and keep the body tall. Set both heels down, feet roughly hip-width apart.
steps.zh: 上背靠墙，身体保持挺直；双脚约与髋同宽，两脚跟踩地。

steps.en: Keep knees softly extended and toes pointing forwards. Shift neither the hips nor the heels during the lift.
steps.zh: 膝自然较直，脚尖朝前；提脚时髋和脚跟不移动。

steps.en: Pull the whole forefoot towards the shins while the heels remain on the floor. Let the toes stay relaxed.
steps.zh: 把整个前脚掌拉向小腿，脚跟仍贴地，脚趾自然放松。

steps.en: Pause at a height you can hold and notice the muscles beside the front of the shin.
steps.zh: 提到能停稳的高度，留意胫骨前缘旁的肌肉用力。

steps.en: Lower the forefeet slowly without slapping the floor. Bring the feet closer to the wall if control fades.
steps.zh: 前脚掌慢慢落下，不拍地；控制变差就把脚收近墙面。

cues.en: Lift the foot, not just the toes.
cues.zh: 抬脚，不只翘脚趾。

cues.en: Keep the heels still and let the ankles do the work.
cues.zh: 脚跟不动，让踝来完成动作。

mistakes.en: Rocking away from the wall. Why: body motion helps fling the forefeet up instead of loading dorsiflexion.
mistakes.zh: 身体离墙前后晃。为什么：身体运动把前脚掌甩起来，背屈不再承担同样负荷。

mistakes.en: Letting the feet slap down. Why: this removes control from the lowering phase.
mistakes.zh: 让脚掌拍地。为什么：下放阶段失去控制。

text.en: Begin close enough to the wall for smooth foot lifts; move the feet farther forward only while the heels stay planted and lowering stays controlled.
text.zh: 先把脚放在能平稳提起的位置；脚跟不移、下放仍能控制时，再把脚逐步放远。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: Choose a stable wall and stop for sharp shin pain, tingling or loss of foot control.
cautions.zh: 墙面要稳；小腿刺痛、麻刺或足部失控就停。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Use a short clear path on a firm non-slip floor, near a fixed support if needed. Wear stable shoes and begin with a comfortable forefoot lift.
setup.zh: 在结实防滑地面找一段无障碍路线，需要时靠近固定扶手。穿稳固鞋，前脚掌抬到舒服高度。

steps.en: Stand tall, then raise the whole forefoot on each side so your weight rests on the heels.
steps.zh: 站稳，把两侧整个前脚掌抬起，让重量落在脚跟。

steps.en: Keep the knees softly extended and the toes facing ahead. Use light hand support if balance is uncertain.
steps.zh: 膝自然较直，脚尖朝前；平衡不稳可轻扶。

steps.en: Take a small step forwards with the left heel, keeping that forefoot lifted as the heel meets the floor.
steps.zh: 左脚跟向前迈小步，着地时前脚掌仍抬起。

steps.en: Transfer weight gently and bring the right heel forwards. Keep the trunk steady and avoid rocking onto the toes.
steps.zh: 轻轻转移重量，右脚跟再向前；躯干稳定，不滚回脚尖。

steps.en: Finish before the forefeet begin to drop or balance becomes rushed. Put the whole feet down before turning around.
steps.zh: 前脚掌开始往下掉、或者要急着找平衡之前就结束；先全脚掌落地，再转身。

cues.en: Keep the forefeet lifted, with quiet heel contacts.
cues.zh: 前脚掌保持抬起，脚跟轻轻着地。

cues.en: Small steps make control easier to notice.
cues.zh: 步子小，更容易控制。

mistakes.en: Marching with the toes raised but the forefoot down. Why: toe extension is not the same as ankle dorsiflexion.
mistakes.zh: 只翘脚趾，前脚掌仍落地。为什么：伸趾不等于踝背屈。

mistakes.en: Taking long stamping steps. Why: impact and hurried balance distract from holding the foot position.
mistakes.zh: 大步跺脚。为什么：冲击和急着稳住身体，会干扰足位控制。

text.en: Begin with stationary forefoot holds or light hand support; progress to quiet steps only while the lifted foot position and balance remain steady.
text.zh: 先原地保持前脚掌抬起，或轻扶；足位与平衡都稳住后，再过渡到轻轻迈步。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: Use support or return to a stationary foot lift if balance is poor. Stop for heel pain or numbness.
cautions.zh: 平衡差就扶稳，或改为原地提脚；脚跟痛或麻木就停。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。

setup.en: Sit on a firm floor with a light band looped over the forefoot and attached to a fixed low anchor in front. Inspect the band and anchor before stretching it.
setup.zh: 坐在结实地面，轻弹力带套前脚掌，固定到正前方低位稳固锚点；拉伸前检查带和固定点。

steps.en: Sit with the left heel supported on the floor and the knee comfortably near straight. Bend the other leg for a relaxed sitting position.
steps.zh: 坐稳，左脚跟有地面支撑，左膝自然较直；另一腿屈起，让坐姿舒服。

steps.en: Place the band across the forefoot rather than the toes. Take up light tension with the ankle slightly pointed away.
steps.zh: 弹力带压在前脚掌，不套脚趾；踝略跖屈，让带轻轻绷紧。

steps.en: Keep the heel and knee still and pull the whole forefoot towards the shin. Avoid turning the sole in or out.
steps.zh: 脚跟和膝不动，把整个前脚掌拉向小腿；足底不向内外转。

steps.en: Pause at a comfortable dorsiflexed position with the toes relaxed. Notice effort beside the shin.
steps.zh: 在舒服的背屈位稍停，脚趾放松，留意胫骨旁用力。

steps.en: Let the band draw the forefoot away slowly. Release the tension before removing the band or changing legs.
steps.zh: 慢慢让带把前脚掌拉回；先卸掉张力，再解带换腿。

cues.en: Draw the shoe towards the shin, not just the toes.
cues.zh: 把鞋面拉向小腿，不只翘脚趾。

cues.en: Keep the heel supported throughout.
cues.zh: 脚跟始终有支撑。

mistakes.en: Letting the band slip onto the toes. Why: it can slip off and changes the movement into toe lifting.
mistakes.zh: 弹力带滑到脚趾上。为什么：容易滑脱，动作也会变成翘脚趾。

mistakes.en: Moving the whole leg to stretch the band. Why: hip and knee motion replace the ankle work.
mistakes.zh: 整条腿移动去拉带。为什么：髋和膝运动代替了踝用力。

text.en: Choose a band that allows smooth ankle motion; increase resistance gradually without shortening the controlled range.
text.zh: 选能平稳移动踝的带；保持可控制幅度，再逐步加大阻力。

text.en: Practise with an effort you can control; a repetition need not reach failure to be useful. Allow recovery before another demanding session.
text.zh: 采用能控制的用力程度；每次不必做到力竭才有用。吃力的训练之间留出恢复。

cautions.en: Do not point a stretched band towards the face; stop if it is frayed or the anchor shifts.
cautions.zh: 拉伸的弹力带不要朝脸；带磨损或固定点移动就停。

cautions.en: First learn the movement with bodyweight or a light load under a qualified coach; anyone under eighteen should practise with adult supervision.
cautions.zh: 第一次做先用自重或轻重量，在合格教练指导下学动作；未满 18 岁在成人监督下练习。

cautions.en: This card is general information, not medical advice. For pain or an injury, see a doctor or physiotherapist.
cautions.zh: 本卡片是一般性知识，不是医疗建议；有疼痛或受伤，请咨询医生或物理治疗师。
